ORR_DESKTOP docs: GitHub publication + README/concept/roadmap + 100% pure-Rust (no external ffmpeg) architecture plan
body:
Documentation + planning band for ORR_DESKTOP (S:/rust/ORR_DESKTOP).

Goal 1 — GitHub publication docs:
- README.md (EN): what the app does, screenshots/GIF placeholder, build (windows-gnu toolchain), run, CLI usage.
- CONCEPT.md: vision, scope, non-goals.
- ROADMAP.md: phased plans (band list) for the rewrite.
- GitHub repo prep: platinoff/ORR_DESKTOP, .gitignore audit, CI sketch (fmt+clippy+test).

Goal 2 — 100% pure Rust architecture plan (hard requirement):
- The app must NOT shell out to side applications. ffmpeg.exe as an external process is banned in the target architecture.
- Document the migration path from current spawn-ffmpeg design to an all-Rust pipeline in the crate structure:
  capture (windows-rs / Windows.Graphics.Capture or GDI fallback) → frame pipeline → encode (pure-Rust encoder crates, e.g. rav1e/openh264 bindings evaluated) → mux (pure-Rust MP4 muxer crate).
- Each stage becomes its own module in src/ structure with trait boundaries so encoders are pluggable.

Deliverable: docs written in S:/rust/ORR_DESKTOP/docs/, one commit in the product repo at drain close. Drain discipline: S0 disk → HANDOFF → fmt → cargo test → one commit.

title: P1: pipeline scaffold — FrameSource/VideoEncoder/Muxer traits + pump, ffspawn legacy wrapper
body:
Band 1 of pure-Rust rewrite (docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 2 entry, docs/ARCHITECTURE_PURE_RUST.md steps 1).

Add src/pipeline.rs with traits FrameSource / VideoEncoder / Muxer + Frame/FrameSpec/Sample types and a run() pump (source→encoder→muxer, finish flush order). Add empty-but-real src/capture/, src/encode/, src/mux/ modules. Extract recorder arg-building into a testable build_args() and add capture/ffspawn.rs legacy wrapper (no behavior change — ffmpeg path stays default).

Acceptance: unit tests with counting fake source + passthrough encoder + memory muxer verify frame count, sample flow, finalize order; existing CLI behavior unchanged; cargo test green.

title: P2: native capture — GDI BitBlt FrameSource (crop parity with gdigrab)
body:
Band 2 (ROADMAP Phase 2, ARCHITECTURE step 2a): src/capture/gdi.rs — BitBlt-based FrameSource producing BGRA frames + pts.

Must match gdigrab crop math exactly: same offset_x/offset_y/video_size semantics as current cli-area, DPI-aware physical pixels, multi-monitor negative origins handled.

Acceptance: pixel-parity test vs ffmpeg gdigrab on a synthetic test pattern (same rect → same dimensions; sampled pixels equal within tolerance); fps pacing independent of GDI blocking.

title: P3: native capture — Windows.Graphics.Capture source (DPI, multi-monitor)
body:
Band 3 (ROADMAP Phase 2): src/capture/wgcap.rs — Windows.Graphics.Capture FrameSource via windows-rs (Direct3D11 texture → BGRA staging readback).

Handles: monitor enumeration with negative origins, per-monitor DPI, cursor drawing option, item creation on Windows 10 1903+ with GDI fallback when API absent.

Acceptance: fullscreen + region session produces correct-dimension frames at requested fps; falls back cleanly to gdi.rs on unsupported hosts; no leaked COM references across start/stop cycles (test loop x50).

title: P4: in-process SW encode (openh264) + MP4 muxer; default switches to native path
body:
Band 4 (ROADMAP Phase 3 core): in-process encode + mux.

src/encode/sw.rs — software H.264 encoder behind VideoEncoder trait using openh264 crate (bundled C via -sys, linked INTO our binary — no external process; rav1e swap evaluated later per ARCHITECTURE_PURE_RUST.md table). BGRA→YUV420 conversion in-house. Quality presets map from existing Quality enum (cq/bitrate semantics preserved as close as codec allows).
src/mux/mp4.rs — MP4 muxer via mp4-muxer crate behind Muxer trait (+faststart-equivalent: moov placement), exact duration on finish.

Acceptance: pipeline::run(gdi_source, sw_encoder, mp4_mux) writes a playable MP4 with zero external executables touched (assert no child processes spawned); ffprobe-free sanity checks in test (ftyp box present, duration == frames/fps ±1).

title: P5: remove ffspawn — zero external executables acceptance
body:
Band 5 (ROADMAP Phase 3 close): delete src/capture/ffspawn.rs and all std::process::Command usage from the record path; recorder.rs keeps only detect/probe for hardware discovery reporting.

Acceptance (clean machine): app records fullscreen + region with ffmpeg NOT installed / ORR_FFMPEG unset; grep proves no Command spawn in src/ except none; output MP4 passes box-walk test (ftyp+moov, duration exact); tray + CLI flows re-verified. This closes ROADMAP Phase 3.

title: P6: HW encoders in-process (NVENC/QSV/AMF via vendor APIs)
body:
Band 6 (ROADMAP Phase 3 stretch): hardware encoders in-process behind VideoEncoder trait — NVENC/QSV/AMF via vendor APIs with D3D11 frame interop (windows-rs). Reuse existing probe philosophy: runtime test-encode validation before selection, priority NVENC > QSV > AMF > SW preserved; Encoder::Auto unchanged UX.

Acceptance: on AMD iGPU host, AMF path produces valid MP4 at 1080p30 with GPU encode confirmed (no CPU-bound SW fallback in profile log); graceful fallback chain when driver rejects init mid-session.

Backend: Epub::cover_image() (OPF properties=cover-image / meta name=cover / nav img), preflight() geometry+base64 data-uri + checks, GET /api/books/{id}/preflight?mode&trim&paper&pages. Reuse standards.rs + coverpdf/pdfwriter. Add base64 encoder.

title: Interactivity: touchpad + keyboard on all surfaces (not only mouse)
body: Кавер-канвас (ui/cover.html): wheel-zoom + Ctrl+± , pinch на canvas-шарах (pointer events замість тільки CSS scale); 3D-сцена (ui/view3d.html + міні-3D у кавері): pinch-zoom замість лише wheel, стрілки ←→↑↓ для обертання, PgUp/PgDn для zoom; studio-рейл списку розділів: HTML5 DnD (draggable/ondragstart) не працює на тачпадах/тачі — замінити на pointer-based reorder; фокус-навігація Tab по всіх кнопках. Критерій: усі поверхні керовані миша+тачпад+клавіатура.

title: Studio: bottom status bar with position buttons (row:col, words, pages, zoom)
body: ui/studio.html: sticky-футер під редактором/переглядом — позиція курсора row:col, слово/символи, поточний розділ, оцінка сторінок, zoom %; кнопки-групи (як у word-processors): Home/End позиції, перемикач перегляду (стрічка ↔ погляд на сторінках). Дані з існуючого paint() + textarea selection. Критерій: футер не ховається у zen (F9), синхронізується з друком.

title: Studio: book spread + page-by-page view (prev/next buttons, page-number jump)
body: Покомірний (pagination) перегляд у студії замість нескінченної стрічки: JS-пагінація превʼю на друковані сторінки за тими ж розмірами поля/шрифту, що src/interior.rs (KDP-таблиця маргінесів), 2 сторінки-поруч «розгортка» (spread, recto/verso) + one-page toggle; внизу кнопки ⏮ ◀ ▶ ⏭ + поле «стор. N of M» (як пагінація на сайтах) + Enter для переходу; мета — бачити як текст поміщається на сторінці (вдовиці/рвати, кінець розділу). Ключ розділу-на-сторінці: data-chapter + блок з md_to_plain-логіки. Критерій: номери сторінок збігаються ±1 з PDF-збором того ж дрофту.

title: Quality: justified PDF with page numbers, font subsetting, HiDPI cover export
body: Якість рендеру/друку: (1) PDF-інтерʼєр — вирівнювання по ширині (justification) і колонтитули з номерами сторінок замість genpdf-обмежень (REBOOK_DEV_PLAN §L138-143), пізніше — власний layout замість genpdf; (2) font subsetting для Cyrillic-вбудови (src/ttf.rs) — прибрати здуття 11.8 MB; (3) експорт кавера PNG у HiDPI (devicePixelRatio×2/×3 замість 1:1 канви ui/cover.html L356-361); (4) закрити KDP-попередження EN cover 125 DPI → ≥300 (preflight already warns). Критерій: ті самі дрофти дають менший PDF, рівний текст і чіткий кавер без втрати метаданих.

title: RB-34: justified PDF layout + font subsetting (genpdf replacement)
body: Наслідок RB-33: genpdf 0.2 не має Alignment::Justify й вбудовує повні шрифти (11.8 MB). Потрібен власний text-layout для інтерʼєру: word-wrap із justification по ширині колонки, лічильник вдов/сиріт, подзвітовий font subsetting у src/ttf.rs (cid→glyph map + new glyf/loca). Критерій: той самий дрофт — вирівняний текст, PDF менший удвічі, номери сторінок як у RB-33.

title: RB-35: clippy hygiene — preflight.rs 2 warnings (band 263 top)
body: Два clippy-попередження в src/preflight.rs з RB-29: L85 matches!(m, 0xC0|0xC1|0xC2|0xC3) → 0xC0..=0xC3; L147 collapsible if href.is_none() { if let Some(id) → let-chain. Критерій: cargo clippy --all-targets — попередження продукту = 0 (rustybuzz future-incompat не рахується).

title: RB-36: preflight UX — show which cover file was found
body: Preflight UX (з NEXT §4): показувати ЯКИЙ файл обкладинки знайдено. CoverArt += pub file: String (href з OPF або ім'я cover.* entry, без OEBPS/); у /view3d warnings panel — рядок "обкладинка: OEBPS/cover.jpeg 751×1200" + DPI при печаті; у Studio meta — теж ім'я знайденого cover.png assets. Критерій: видно шлях/ім'я файла, не лише пікселі.

title: RB-37: dust-jacket 3D wrap on /view3d + cover mini-3D (RB-27b)
body: Dust-jacket 3D (RB-27b, з alert у cover.html build3d): на /view3d і в міні-3D кавера режим dj — обгортка з крильцями: front-panel + hinge + spine + hinge + back-panel як єдиний wrap під кутом ~75-80° до case (CSS preserve-3d), flap width 0.6in, окрема група .dj поверх hc-геометрії (dims already has dj case constants). Додати форм-фактор dust jacket у select /view3d (hc під ним). Критерій: dj не alert'ить, обертається, крильця видно при ry ~ ±60°.

title: RB-38: RB-16c raster image embedding in cover-wrap PDF (DCTDecode XObject)
body: RB-16c лишилось (subsetting зроблено в RB-34): растерове зображення всередині cover-wrap PDF. pdfwriter: /XObject /Image DCTDecode (JPEG bytes як-is — з data-URI coverdoc.front_image) + place() через cm+Do у вільну зону front panel (slice-подібний cover crop через clipping). PNG → попередження 'convert to JPEG' (без transcoding у Rust). Критерій: build обкладинки з картинкою дає wrap-PDF де картинка в MediaBox, ink-TAC gate не ламається, lopdf парсить, розмір зростає лише на вагу JPEG.

title: RB-39: products discovery per-book roots (live bug: /Продукти порожні при реальних zip)
body: BUG з live-обходу 9800-сервера: /api/products=[] хоча en/products/ містить ebook/ hardcover/ rust-before-sleep-hc.zip. Причина: web.rs products_root=relative "products" (cwd-dependent) і list_products чекає layout <root>/<slug>/{fmt}. Правка: скан обʼєднання коренів — cwd products/ + для кожного книги полиці sibling <bookdir>/products (path .\en\build\x.epub → en/products), толерантний layout (fmt-директорії одразу під root = slug з ebook-файла/маніфесту); download-резолвер той самий список. Критерій: /products показує hc-пакет rust-before-sleep із Live-сервера, завантаження zip 200.

title: RB-40: build-epub --cover flag (close uk no-cover gap)

Anyone can farm +15 or demote rivals, review/tests_ok=false griefs by report. Tests: farming rejected, earned moves work.

body: Bug-hunt 1 finding (deferred, needs owner call): /edge/upstream/* reverse proxy forwards POSTs to poolAI/llama with NO initData check — anonymous tunnel callers can burn inference and spend the server poolAI bearer. Phones have initData, so gating is feasible (attach initData in tensor.js/probe.js/chat calls), but it changes the live PoC loop — do NOT land blind, verify from phones. Deliverable: initData gate on proxy POSTs (GETs stay open for status reads) + phone-verified worker loop. Product telenetis (same GSV repo).

title: ops: restart live :9999 in owner window (activate browser_peers lane)
body: Deferred owner-window task (do NOT execute mid-session): restart live gsv-server :9999 so queued code takes effect — grid planner browser_peers lane (236b6b1, webgpu slice sizing + planner webgpu class) plus any later GSV commits. MCP/tool transport may ride :9999, so restart only in an owner-confirmed window with watchdog respawn verified after (health + version match crate). Product gsv.

title: sec owner-gated: rotate Telenetis bot token (exposed in chat transcript)
body: Owner-only, ASAP for hygiene: the Telenetis bot token was visible in agent diagnostic outputs in chat during bug-hunt 2 (local tool-output files cleaned, chat transcript remains). Revoke via BotFather, put the new token in S:/rust/telenetis/.env TELENETIS_BOT_TOKEN (gitignored; sibling repo after the split), restart :9800 live (kill bot only — supervisor refreshes), verify /start reply + webhook registered in target/live/logs. Product telenetis.

title: owner call: group reply ownership (telenetis vs gsv bot official)
body: Owner decision needed: who answers commands in the group — gsv bot official, Telenetis, or both? History: Telenetis answered everything (user saw replies, attributed to gsv bot official), then a mute commit silenced it (group went fully silent), then mute reverted. Candidates for real duplicates: two live bots, webhook+poll double delivery, or /start==/help identical text. Deliverable: owner picks single owner; loser mutes group replies (keep private + app) or scopes commands. Needs owner + phone verification. Product telenetis.

title: swarm follow-up: WS tracker for phone-to-phone torrent P2P
body: Follow-up of the torrent ticket (webseed transport works): real phone-to-phone P2P needs a WebSocket tracker (browsers cannot do UDP DHT). Options: (a) minimal Rust WS tracker in GSV/telenetis, (b) public tracker announce (privacy + dependence), (c) PC-hosted tracker binary. Deliverable: chosen tracker + tensor.js announces to it + measured phone-to-phone bytes with piece verification + HTTP fallback intact. Needs two phones online with models. Product telenetis.

title: telenetis ресерч: правильне створення Telegram аплікації
body: Абракадабра з-під GSV, виключно telenetis. Ресерч 2026-09-17: правильне створення аплікації в Telegram (BotFather /newbot+/newapp, Main Mini App + menu button setChatMenuButton, HTTPS-only web_app URL, initData HMAC-SHA256 WebAppData + auth_date freshness + third-party Ed25519, webhook secret_token vs long-polling getUpdates, answerWebAppQuery/can_send_after). Звірити з поточним telenetis/src/bot/telegram.rs + security/initdata + tunnel. Вихід: чеклист створення + gaps в docs/telenetis.

title: telenetis ресерч: storage/RAM/CPU/GPU + автономна робота згорнутої аплікації
body: Ресурси пристроїв: WebGPU probe (navigator.gpu.requestAdapter, adapter info/limits, powerPreference, compatibility featureLevel), deviceMemory, OPFS/IndexedDB кеш GGUF, Download-folder Save/File picker (вже є в tensor.js), RAM/CPU префлайт. Автономна робота якщо згорнута: WebView lifecycle Telegram (suspend/reload, no ServiceWorker на iOS, no reliable beforeunload) → стратегія: інкрементальний save в localStorage + backend, WS падіння → polling fallback + bot-message як out-of-band push, WakeLock тільки при активній, BackgroundFetch лише для великих файлів. Вихід: матриця можливостей + що реально тримає Telenetis /probe + /tensor.

Вихід: карта потоків phone→telenetis→gsv/poolai/llama + що автоматизувати в OpenBot.

Адаптувати: кожен розділ починається з вердикту одним рядком; кожен пункт тегується ✅ є в коді / ❌ нема / ⏳ чекає власника / 🚫 не робимо; окремий словник сутностей (Bot vs Mini App vs OpenBot vs hub). title: Godfather poller dead: webhook blocks getUpdates; Galaxy stays green
body:
Root cause (loopback POST /api/telegram/poll, 2026-09-18): Telegram returns "Conflict: can't use getUpdates method while webhook is active; use deleteWebhook to delete the webhook first".
Live GET /api/telegram: bot GsvOfficialBot, polling=true, poll_alive=true, last_poll_ts="", update_offset=0, last_ingest empty, bus messages=[]. Telenetis Mini App uses setWebhook; GSV Godfather uses getUpdates. One bot cannot do both.
Bug 2: poll_once fetch_inbound_live Err path returns bus_fail without record_last (telegram.rs ~2012) and spawn_poll_loop ignores the Value (`let _ = poll_once`). Galaxy pills "polling on" / "poll loop alive" while last_poll_ts stays empty for hours - owner sees no bot messages and no error.
Do NOT deleteWebhook until owner confirms GsvOfficialBot vs Telenetis bot are distinct tokens. Related open: t-1789606667836911200 (group reply ownership).
Fix: record_last(false, err) + last_poll_ts on getUpdates Err; Galaxy warn pill when poll_alive && last_poll_ts empty; owner pick webhook XOR poller.

title: PH-203j: prefill matmul row-batched AVX2 (bit-exact, latency-bound dot_f32 chain)
body: 2026-10-21 continuation of PH-203i. Prefill is 23.46 s / 961 tok and the remainder is the matmul: kernel::matmul_reuse calls dot_f32_dispatch per (block,row) = 4-FMA serial chain + hsum + runtime feature check each ~54 cycles for 32 MACs -> ~2.2 GMAC/s/thread, latency-bound not throughput-bound. Slice: row-batch the inner loop (groups of 4 rows sharing one dequantized block buffer, per-row FMA chain and hsum_ps_sse2 order preserved so results stay bit-identical), hoist AVX2/FMA detection out of the block loop, keep the scalar fallback for non-x86/tail rows. Gate: matmul_matches_rowwise_matvec + a new bit-exact test (rows not a multiple of 4), benches/quant prefill 4864x896x961 before/after, fresh :8090 prefill 961 tok, --ignored green without golden recapture (no numeric reorder).

title: PH-203k: prefill matmul activation tiling (L2) + row-split projections
body: PH-203j showed the prefill matmul is not loop-shape limited. Diagnosis: matmul_reuse scans the whole 961x896 f32 activation matrix (3.3 MiB) per weight row (~16 GiB of X traffic from L3 per projection), and QMat::matmul split work by output columns so all 12 workers fed the same X stream. Slice: walk X in MATMUL_ROW_TILE=16 row tiles (57 KiB, L2-resident) preserving per-(row,r) block order (bit-exact), and split the projection by input rows so each worker keeps ~290 KiB of X in L2 and re-reads the few-MiB weights instead. Gate: matmul_activation_tiling_is_bit_identical (tiles 1/3/31/32/64/128 vs single tile), qmat parallel_matmul_is_bit_identical_to_serial, benches/quant A/B in one process, clippy/fmt, live :8090 health.

title: PH-203l: prefill matmul full-row f32 accumulator (numeric slice + golden recapture)
body: PH-203k made the prefill matmul cache-friendly; what is left is the per-(row,r) cost: matmul_reuse dequantizes in 32 (or 256) element blocks and calls dot_f32_dispatch per block, so every (row, r) pays 28 fused-call + hsum costs (each hsum is a 5-op serial reduction on a 4-FMA chain). Slice: dequantize the WHOLE weight row once into a row buffer and run one f32 dot over n per (row, r) — one hsum instead of 28, same memory traffic. This changes the summation order (per-block hsum added into f32 acc vs one 8-lane partial accumulator over the row), so it is a NUMERIC slice: bench A/B against the block-wise path in one process, tolerance test vs the old path, and golden recapture with RUSTY_CAPTURE_GOLDEN=1 followed by a clean --ignored run + fingerprint check.

title: PH-203m: per-stage prefill profiler (RUSTY_PROFILE) + matmul shape table
body: Prefill 961 tok is 19-20 s and every guess about where it goes has been wrong so far (PH-203j/K/L). Slice: add RUSTY_PROFILE=1 stage accounting (matvec/matmul/attention) with a per-shape matmul table, hook it into the serve prefill and the re-prefill CLI path, keep it free when off, and use it to pick the next hot slice with evidence instead of intuition.

title: PH-203n: prefill register blocking + 2-D cache blocking + parallel split axis (bit-identical)
body: PH-203m left prefill at 15-20 s with 84 % in matmul and the down projection (896x4864) at 10 GMAC/s against 35-51 for the rest. PH-203l's analysis said dot_f32 is load-port bound at 1 FMA / 2 loads (82 % of the AVX2 limit), so the levers are (a) register blocking: four activation rows per weight load, (b) loop order: tile X outside the weight loop, since `for r { for every row }` re-reads the whole X (18.7 MiB) from DRAM per weight row, and (c) parallel split axis, because twelve 1.56 MiB slices of X evict each other from the 8 MiB L3. All three are bit-identical (only independent iteration order changes), so the golden must stay green with no recapture. Evidence: single-thread bench A/B (rows1/rb1/blocked hooks) on both shapes, pool A/B of the two split axes, clean gate (fmt/clippy/tests + release --ignored), and live prefill probe with RUSTY_PROFILE.

title: PH-203o: prefill attention — x4 score dots, vector axpy, round-robin rows (2.02 -> 0.84 s)
body: After PH-203n the profiler puts prefill attention at 2.02 s of 10.44 s (19.3 %, 24 x 84 ms) even though it is already fanned out across heads. The arithmetic says it is scalar, not memory bound: ~9.9 G MAC of scores summed element by element (1 MAC/cycle) plus the same count of scalar value FMAs. Slice: score four keys per query load with the existing x4 register-blocked dot, add an AVX2 axpy for the value accumulation (mul+add, so bit-exact against the scalar loop it replaces), and fix the work split (14 heads on 12 workers = two waves; rows cost O(i), so deal them round-robin). Evidence: kernel exactness test for axpy, a round/rounds bit-identical test for the context assembly, clean gate, release --ignored fingerprint (the score reorder is a numeric slice), and 4 live prefill probes with RUSTY_PROFILE.

title: MC-2: Real-weight device-side inference — phone/PC browser peers compute matvec_shard against delivered Q8 weights
body:
MiniCPM-mesh (plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-15-minicpm-mesh-wsp.md), milestone M2. Depends on MC-3.

Goal: browser peers (Android WebGPU, PC wgpu/DX12) consume weight-shard envelopes from the hub store and run Q8/matvec_shard against device-resident weights (no toy generators); hub verifies partials vs CPU shard-reference (max_err_model <= 1e-2).

Scope:
- extend the task envelope: weight_ref (store key) + shard_index/total_shards + tensor name; backward-compatible with the 7 existing ops

Single-token full-depth vector and 4-token 1-block smoke both exist; produce the full 27/27 4-token prefix via staged checkpoint resume (data/vision_prefix_1b_mt4_cp.json, --image-tokens 4, shards 2) into L:/gsv_mirror/models/gsv-versus-ai/vision_prefix_1024_mt4_full.f32. Stage 3 EXIT=0 (2591s, next_block=3); stages 6..27 in flight. Gate: finite, ok under hub 1e-2, prefix_tokens=4, all 27 blocks. Then re-run rusty --vision-prefix --vision-at 3 and compare with 1-block mt4 and zero baselines. No image->answer/quality claim; PH-1204 alignment and G13 open. EVIDENCE 2026-11-26: stages 6..27 all EXIT=0, next_block=27; full vector vision_prefix_1024_mt4_full.f32 (16384 B, sha bbdcf2f9..., 4 tokens x 1024, 296 cluster ops in final stage, finite, ok=true, max_abs 1.79). rusty --vision-at 3 gives degenerate text ('1. 1. 1'), zero baseline '是 的 的 的', 1-block mt4 earlier 'This is a photo of a game' — full-depth did NOT improve grounding; trained alignment still required.

title: GASV-G45: MiniCPM-V 4.7 vision forward architecture corrections (tok_embd_sep + post_ln)
body: Root cause re-check: the 4-token Q4_K vision forward used zero class embeddings for minicpmv4_7 and applied v.post_ln BEFORE the ViT stack. Real MiniCPM-V 4.7 mmproj has v.tok_embd_sep [1024,4] (trained embeddings for exactly four pooled positions) and v.post_ln belongs AFTER the stack. Fixed vision_forward.rs: load tok_embd_sep, add its 4 vectors as token biases, and apply post_ln after blocks (inkling2v pre_ln path unchanged). Unit/clippy green; 1-block 4-token live smoke in flight to compare rusty --vision-prefix output with earlier degenerate baselines. EVIDENCE 2026-11-26: smoke EXIT=0, 119 cluster ops, 1131s, finite, ok=true, proof_gate_ok=true (first time under strict 1e-4 — earlier full-depth runs were only under hub 1e-2), max_abs 1.919; prefix vision_prefix_1024_mt4_fixed.f32 (sha in sidecar). rusty --vision-at 3 -> 'The group is a group of', --vision-at 0 -> 'In the picture, the picture,' — changed vs '1. 1. 1' but STILL not image-grounded. Architecture correction is numerically valid; trained alignment remains open.

title: GASV-G46: multi-peer routing check with two connected phones (#39 bifrost, #44 valhall)
body: Owner connected two phones; mesh alive_ids [43,39,44], all ready_alive=3 after six matmul64 probes. Run the G45-corrected 4-token Q4_K vision forward with --shards 4 so shards spread across the three peers; collect route ids and per-shard elapsed_ms, compare wall time with the single-peer 119-op/1131s smoke. Then compare rusty --vision-prefix output. No image->answer/quality claim; PH-1204 alignment and G13 open. UPDATE: mesh had alive_ids [43,39,44] ready 3/3, but --shards 4 spread patch_embd to phones #39/#44 and both posted garbage partials (`model mismatch: max_err_model 4.08e9 / 5.62e9`, rows 288..576 and 864..1152); group g-7189 never completed. Likely stale phone /wgpu pages or WASM cache — needs page reload on both phones; hub correctly rejected bad partials. Falling back to --shards 2 with #43 for the forward. RESULT: --shards 2 fallback EXIT=0, 119 ops, 781s, finite, ok=true, proof_gate_ok=true, max_abs 1.919; prefix vision_prefix_1024_mt4_multi.f32 matches the G45 fixed vector; rusty --vision-at 3 gives the same 'The group is a group of'. Three-peer routing blocked by stale phone pages (reload /wgpu on #39/#44 needed), not by the hub lane.

title: GASV-G49: final 3-peer routing check after JS-fallback phone page reload
body: Owner reloaded /wgpu on #39/#44 again with runWeightsMatvecJs active. Mesh alive_ids [43,39,44], ready_alive=3 after probes. Re-run G45-corrected 4-token Q4_K vision forward with --shards 4; verify no model-mismatch rejects, collect route ids, per-shard elapsed_ms and wall time vs 781s single-peer. Export vision_prefix_1024_mt4_3peer.f32. No image->answer/quality claim; PH-1204 alignment and G13 open. RESULT: --shards 4 still failed (g-7343) with byte-identical errors after the JS page reload — the error value is deterministic, pointing to a corrupted IndexedDB chunk cache: phones lack crypto.subtle on the insecure LAN origin, so cached bytes are never verified and are reused forever. Fix: /wgpu now bypasses idbGet/idbPut entirely for phone peers and always re-fetches authoritative bytes from the hub; contract 12/12, deployed. One more phone reload needed. FINAL 2026-11-26: after that reload the phones DID take the JS-fallback page (console confirms 'phone JS fallback'), chunk cache bypass active, but --shards 4 still failed (g-7352) with the identical mismatch. The rejected partials have sane first values (~0.22), so the divergence is in the hub's numeric reference for those row ranges (288..576, 864..1152) of the 588-col Q4_K tensor, not in phone cache or matvec. Previous cache hypothesis DISPROVEN. Phones can join/ready/probe but are not authoritative for this reshape tensor; #43 remains the compute peer.

title: BUG candidate: hub weights_matvec_reference_segment mismatch on Q4_K rows with 588 cols
body: Open follow-up, not fixed here. With three ready peers (#43 PC, #39 bifrost, #44 valhall), --shards 4 on vf_minicpmv4_7_minicpm1b-vision-q4k_patch_embd (1152x588, Q4_K artifact-backed) always rejects shards covering rows 288..576 and 864..1152 with max_err_model 4.0757e9 / 5.6174e9, while shards 0..288 and 576..864 pass on #43. Phone partials have sane first values (~0.22) across WebGPU, WASM SIMD and golden-tested JS dequant paths, and a phone IndexedDB bypass did not change the result — so the divergence is likely in the hub reference's Q4_K block-range handling for non-256-aligned boundaries (288*588=169344). Need a focused unit test of weights_matvec_reference_segment against rusty-engine oracle for those row ranges before any fix. Not a blocker: #43 remains authoritative for the vision forward.

title: LOAD-3: coalescing multi-range read scheduler (sort + gap-merge, rayon)
body: Owner 2026-11-26 go, adapted plan step 5. LOAD-1 full pack parked (19.45 GiB doesn't fit L: 19 GiB), but mbolt measured sorted+gap-merged positional reads +13-14% end-to-end with ~370 vs 1418 reads/token. Use rayon (already dep) for ~8 parallel reads. TDD: overlapping/adjacent ranges coalesced into one read, split results exact, tamper fails closed. Wire into tensor_raw_range/moe_forward if safe; else keep helper + benchmark. No new deps. NUMERICS ONLY, no quality claim (G13). Claim->done.

title: LOAD-5: octet-stream chunk GET + phone IDB hash-check
body: Owner 2026-11-26 go, adapted research plan step 6. Chunk GET currently returns {ok,key,data_b64} (~33% inflation + atob/Uint8Array.from copies, wgpu.rs:3421-3433); phones bypass IndexedDB because insecure LAN origin has no crypto.subtle (wgpu.rs:3414-3419), so they re-download every chunk each task. LOAD-5: (1) add `GET /api/wgpu/weights/chunk/raw?key=<sha256>` returning application/octet-stream bytes with a `x-gsv-key`/digest header; keep existing base64 endpoint for compatibility; (2) page downloadWeightsFlat uses raw path when available with arrayBuffer(); (3) let phones reuse IDB entries verified against the hub-supplied digest (no crypto.subtle needed — compare key string from hub header against content-addressed cache key; corrupt entry is detected by hub golden-x anyway); (4) TDD: raw GET returns exact bytes + header, page markers present. No new deps. NUMERICS ONLY, no quality claim (G13). Claim->done.
